full_judgment: 17. If for the sake of argument, it is taken as granted that alleged transfer made by Makhani Bewa of minor Ratan Moridal in favour of Hasina Warda Chowdhury, the predecessor of the defendant is not a valid deed, nevertheless, the suit is barred by limitation as Ratan Mondal did not take any legal action challenging the legality of the deeds executed by her mother in 1970 within the stipulated time nor filed a suit for recovery of the khas possession from the defendants after attaining majority; therefore, the suit was barred by limitation.
